title: FII U-Turn: ₹84,290 Cr Bought in 9 Days — Nifty +13% Explained
description:
2 months selling. 9 days to undo it all.

Foreign Institutional Investors bought ₹84,290 Cr in just 9 sessions (Nov 2–13, 2026), reversing a 2-month selloff of ₹70,704 Cr. Nifty 50 rose +13% from its October 8 low.

This video covers:
• Week-by-week FII buying data
• Why FIIs came back (3 key reasons)
• Sectors they targeted
• What to watch next
